### [Trade in Minutes! Rationality-Driven Agentic System for Quantitative Financial Trading](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04787>)

**Catalog ID:** 2026-iclr-song-trade-in-minutes

**Authors:** Zifan Song, Kaitao Song, Guosheng Hu, Ding Qi, Junyao Gao, Xiaohua Wang, Dongsheng Li, Cairong Zhao

**Venue / year:** ICLR · 2026

**Track / presentation:** Main · Poster

**Status / verified:** Accepted · 2026-08-12

**Topics:** Financial Agents · Execution · Alpha Modeling · Risk Management

**Assets / frequency:** Equities, Crypto · Intraday

**Tasks:** quantitative trading · strategy generation · trading-agent deployment

**Methods:** large language models · multi-agent systems · closed-loop optimization

**Identifiers:** arXiv 2510.04787 · DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2510.04787

**Focus:** Uses a rationality-driven multi-agent system to separate LLM strategy development from minute-level trading-bot deployment across stock and crypto markets.

**Why it matters:** Connects language-model strategy generation to executable trading policies with profitability, action-efficiency, and risk-control tests.
